Event.EventTitle: Board of Mayor and Alderman Regular Meeting

AgendaItems.Title: Public Comments:
AgendaItems.Description: The public comments must be germane to items on the agenda. Each participant is allowed up to 3 minutes each with a combined time limit of no more than 30 minutes.

AgendaItems.Title: Consent Agenda:
AgendaItems.Description:
a.  Approval of the Minutes of June 9, 2026, Regular Board Meeting.

b.  Approval of the 2026-2027 contract with HBS for Town Lobbying Services and for the Town Administrator to sign the contract upon BOMA approval. 

c.  Approval of the apparent Low Bid for the Heritage Commons Paving from Nickell Contracting, LLC and for the Mayor to sign the contract.

d.  Approve the Interlocal Agreement between the Town and Williamson County Emergency Communications District for Dispatch Services, as included in the FY 2026-2027 Town Budget.

e.  Approval of a Development Agreement for Fountain View Subdivision

f.   Approve emergency purchase of a Blower for the Wastewater Treatment Plant.

g.  Approve purchase of a Trachoe for the Public Works Department.
